==Skin==
This item has the same [[skin]] as the [[Straw Effigy]].

**For [[Illusion Magic]], [[Death Magic]], [[Energy Storage]], [[Protection Prayers]], and [[Restoration Magic]], focus item from collector [[Kilgor Rageheart]]
**For [[Inspiration Magic]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fire Magic]], [[Smiting Prayers]], and [[Channeling Magic]], focus item from collector [[Danira]]

== Unique counterparts ==

*[[Heart of the Kinslayer]] has stats identical to the [[Divine Favor]] version of this item.
*[[Destructive Focus]] has stats identical to the [[Curses]] version of this item.
*[[Focus of the Master]] has stats identical to the [[Soul Reaping]] version of this item.
*[[Alitta's Focus]] has stats identical to the [[Illusion Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Lushivahr's Prism]] and [[Gloop's Focus]] have stats identical to the [[Air Magic]] version of this item. 
*[[Hajok's Prism]] has stats identical to the [[Earth Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Mekir's Prism]] and [[Prismatic Focus]] have stats identical to the [[Energy Storage]] version of this item.
*[[Kormab's Prism]] has stats identical to the [[Fire Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Antiquated Focus]], [[Buhon's Prism]], and [[Crystal Focus]] have stats identical to the [[Water Magic]] version of this item.
*[[Oola's Focus]] has stats identical to the [[Restoration Magic]] version of this item.

==Dye==
Unlike most other unique weapons, this item can be [[dye]]d. Dye affects the entire item. The default color can be closely replicated using brown dye.

* The [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], and [[Energy Storage]] requirement Straw Effigies were not initially available when their respective collectors were introduced.
